sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT KIND OF PETS THE OTHER CALLER HAS.
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hello!

ParticipantA: So, what kind of pets do you have?
ParticipantB: Oh, I have a dog.
ParticipantA: Nice! What kind of dog is it?
ParticipantB: It's a golden retriever.
ParticipantA: Oh, I love golden retrievers. I actually have a friend who has one, and it's such a great breed.
ParticipantB: Yeah, mine is really friendly and loving.
ParticipantA: That's great. I used to have a dog when I was younger, but I haven't had one in a while.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I can understand that. Pets require a lot of time and attention.
ParticipantA: Absolutely. I work as a real estate agent, and it can be pretty hectic, so I haven't had the time to take care of a pet.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I work as a bank teller, and it can be pretty busy too. But I make sure to take my dog for a walk every day, even if it's just a quick one.
ParticipantA: That's great. I've been thinking about getting a pet again, but I'm not sure I'm ready for the responsibility.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it's a big commitment. But if you're ready for it, it can be really rewarding.
ParticipantA: Absolutely. I've heard that pets can provide a lot of emotional support and companionship.
ParticipantB: Yeah, my dog is always there for me when I need someone to talk to.
ParticipantA: That's great. I know someone close who has a cat, and they say the same thing. Cats are great companions too.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I've always been a dog person, but I can see the appeal of having a cat as a pet.
ParticipantA: Absolutely. Pets are great companions and can bring a lot of joy to our lives.

ParticipantB: Yeah, they really can. Well, thanks for chatting with me about pets. It was nice talking to you.
ParticipantA: Yeah, likewise. Take care!
